p: long war between the house of: That is, without intermission enduring two years, which was the whole reign of Ishbosheth.
Chileab: Who is also called Daniel, 1Ch 3:1.
Hebron: Within seven years and six months.
dog's head: Do you esteem me no more than a dog, for all my service done to your father's house?
So do God to Abner: We see how the wicked cannot abide being admonished about their faults, but seek their displeasure, who go about to bring them from their wickedness.
communication with the elders of Israel: Rather for malice that he bore toward Ishbosheth, than for love he bore to David.
house of Benjamin: Who challenged the kingdom, because of their father Saul.
from pursuing a troop: From war against the Philistines.
What hast thou done: Here appears the malicious mind of Joab, who would have had the king slay Abner for his private grudge.
guiltless before the LORD for ever: the Lord knows that I did not consent to his death.
Abishai his brother slew Abner: Abishai is said to slay him with Joab, because he consented to the murder.
before Abner: Meaning before the corpse.
as a fool dieth: He declares that Abner died not as a wretch or vile person, but as a valiant man might do, being traitorously deceived by the wicked.
meat while it was yet day: According to their custom, which was to feast at burials.
pleased them: It is expedient sometimes not only to conceive inward sorrow, but also that it may appear to others, so that they may be satisfied.
